description: This header file provides utility functions and classes for testing and manipulating internal representations of string data structures in the Abseil library, specifically related to 'cord' data structures such as substrings, flats, external nodes, and B-trees.

classes.name: AutoUnref
classes.description: RAII helper class that automatically unreferences stored CordRep pointers upon destruction.

methods.name: MakeSubstring
methods.description: Creates a substring representation of a CordRep starting at a given index with specified length.

methods.name: MakeFlat
methods.description: Creates a flat CordRep from a string view.

methods.name: MakeExternal
methods.description: Creates an external CordRep node for testing, wrapping a string.

methods.name: CreateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length from alphanumeric and symbol characters.

methods.name: CreateFlatsFromString
methods.description: Splits a string into multiple flat CordReps of specified chunk size.

methods.name: CordRepBtreeFromFlats
methods.description: Builds a B-tree CordRep from a list of flat CordReps.

methods.name: CordVisitReps
methods.description: Visits all CordReps in a structure, applying a provided function.

methods.name: CordCollectRepsIf
methods.description: Collects CordReps that satisfy a predicate.

methods.name: CordCollectReps
methods.description: Collects all CordReps in a structure.

methods.name: CordToString
methods.description: Converts a CordRep structure into a string.

methods.name: AutoUnref
methods.description: Helper class that automatically unreferences CordReps on destruction.
